title: An idea becomes a connected system — Painterly 3D

scenes.title: Dawn lake, the idea surfaces
scenes.purpose: Establish a hazy cool-dawn alpine lake and let the terracotta idea sphere emerge as the single focal pop.
visuals: Stationary painted dawn sky (pale mint-grey to lavender-blue)
Hazy low-poly ridges and conifer shore
Slate-teal water with static white contour lines
Faceted terracotta idea sphere with locked brush bands
Lilac cast shadow and crisp ripple ring

beats.development: Establishing view: camera begins a slow translation-only dolly over the calm lake.
Idea sphere rises from the water and grows with a warm glow; a ripple ring spreads; headline 'An idea' fades up and subtitle follows.

scenes.title: Connections reach out
scenes.purpose: Show the idea becoming a system: ink rods extend and sage/terracotta nodes surface where they land.
visuals: Rods grow from the idea toward three nodes, then onward to two more
Nodes pop up from the water with ripple rings
Coloured rod and node shadows extend across the water
Accent rule draws under the subtitle

beats.development: First three nodes surface as their rods arrive; accent rule draws under the copy.
Second-tier rods link the upper node to two more nodes; the last node pops and the dawn light and camera settle.

scenes.title: Settled system
scenes.purpose: Hold the finished connected system and full copy for reading.
visuals: Static final composition; ripple rings finish fading by about 2.6 s

beats.development: Reading hold on the settled scene and copy.

findings: The headline is fully legible from 0.85 s and the subtitle from 1.3 s, so each gets more than 1.3 s of settled reading time.
Node pops are staggered about 0.1 s apart so the eye can trace the rods outward from the idea.
All motion is settled by 2.4 s; the last ripple fades by about 2.6 s, before the 2.7 s settle requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.4–3.0 s final hold so the completed system and copy can be read.

notes: Recipe demonstrated: none were supplied (preview_recipes is empty). This refresh demonstrates the source-frame lessons instead: a scene-dependent cool dawn lake background, matte faceted low-poly forms, cool lilac coloured shadows, aerial haze, a contour-line water shader and crisp ripple rings that confirm each event.
Renderer fallback: Blender could not launch in the sandbox (it crashes while probing the Metal GPU), so the scene uses Three.js WebGL with custom painterly shaders.
